control.description-key: Live heatmap of yard slots: occupancy, dwell time and changes as they happen. Works on any table that has a block, row and bay column.

property-set.name: block
property-set.description-key: Yard block or zone the slot belongs to.

property-set.name: status
property-set.description-key: Slot status, e.g. Free, Occupied, Reserved, Blocked.

property-set.name: dwellHours
property-set.description-key: How long the current unit has been in the slot.

property-set.name: unit
property-set.description-key: Unit in the slot, e.g. a VIN or container number.

property.name: colorBy
property.description-key: Colour slots by their status or by how long the unit has been on the yard.

property.name: dwellAlertHours
property.description-key: Units on the yard for at least this many hours are flagged as overdue.
